Whimsical refined storybook fantasy, painterly 3D depth, emerald teal foliage and warm golden rim lighting, highly readable silhouette for a middle-school math strategy game in an enchanted greenhouse. Entire figure and can visible with generous clear padding, no platform, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers. Centered square composition. Warm and capable, not toddler style.
